name: Gebris
description: A mean-spirited teenage novice Azorius guard who taunts and kicks a prisoner and urges moving the prisoners through the sunlit yard.

timeline.summary: Branko guards kneeling Golgari prisoners in the basement corridor of the Detention Compound while the first floor is lost to a revolt.
timeline.quote: some of the Golgari overwhelmed their captors and gained control of the first floor.

timeline.summary: Gebris taunts a Golgari prisoner and presses his boot to the man's face, provoking the prisoners to hiss and growl.
timeline.quote: Gebris took the toe of his boot and shoved it against the man's face

timeline.summary: Gebris blames the Golgari for planning the raid, and Branko agrees to move the prisoners through the sunlit exercise yard to the South Block pens.
timeline.quote: "Let's take them through the exercise yard," Gebris urged.

relations.note: He taunts and abuses the prisoners.
relations.quote: "Now, that's a rat face," Gebris taunted.

pages_say.description: A mean-spirited teenage novice Azorius guard who taunts and kicks a prisoner and urges moving the prisoners through the sunlit yard.
